gspot 0.1.0 · [Source definition](https://github.com/stefanionescu/gspot/blob/main/presets/concern/security/manifest.toml)

Static analysis for security patterns with Semgrep over every file a selected language claims, and CodeQL on request.

Kind: concern.

## Tools

- semgrep 1.152.0
- codeql 2.23.1

## Generated configuration

- `.gspot/semgrep/node.yml`
- `.gspot/semgrep/secrets.yml`
- `.semgrepignore`

## Checks

| Check                                                                      | Stage  | What it finds                                                                                                       |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`security/semgrep`](/reference/rules/security/semgrep/)                   | push   | Runs the Semgrep rule packs of the selected presets, and the repository's own rules, over the changed files.        |
| [`security/semgrep-registry`](/reference/rules/security/semgrep-registry/) | manual | Runs the public Semgrep registry packs named in tools.semgrep.registry, which the registry serves over the network. |
| [`security/codeql`](/reference/rules/security/codeql/)                     | manual | Builds a CodeQL database for every language in tools.codeql.languages and runs the security suite over it.          |

## Settings

- `tools.codeql.languages`: The CodeQL languages to scan, such as javascript-typescript, python, or swift.
- `tools.codeql.suite`: The CodeQL query suite: security-extended, or security-and-quality.
- `tools.codeql.false_positives`: CodeQL results accepted as false positives: the rule id, the paths, and the reason.
- `tools.semgrep.rules`: Rule files or folders of the repository that Semgrep runs beside the shipped packs.
- `tools.semgrep.registry`: The registry packs the manual registry check runs.
- `tools.semgrep.ignore`: Paths Semgrep never scans, each with a reason; they are written into .semgrepignore.
